screens.question: Put the usual stages in order.

hints.text: Which stages are cheap for the firm to run on thousands of people?
Automated tests and videos come first.
Application, online assessment, video or call, technical rounds, final round, offer.

feedback.correct: Cheap, automated stages first; people's time last.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. The firm filters with cheap stages before it spends interviewers' time.

byKey.oa: The online test is an early, cheap filter, straight after the application.
byKey.vid: The online test and the video often come together, straight after the application.
byKey.tech: Technical rounds come after the early filters.
byKey.final: The final round comes after the technical rounds.

explain.text: Firms filter with automated stages first, because they cost little. Interviewers' time comes later, for fewer candidates. Not every firm has every stage: Jane Street's traders report no online test.
